consumer: The engine dialogue/condition evaluator that runs the u_has_item/npc_has_item conditional lambda and asks 'does this character possess item X' to gate a mission/dialogue branch.
scope: The character actor's own possession reach (charges_of + has_amount over the avatar's inventory/wielded/worn), matching what a mission or dialogue possession check evaluates.
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_item builds the lambda actor->charges_of(item_id)>0 || actor->has_amount(item_id,1), i.e. the engine's own u_has_item/npc_has_item predicate value.
divergence: Item X sits in an adjacent vehicle cargo tile the avatar can reach but has not picked up: the possession predicate correctly returns false, whereas a re-derivation over reachable inventory would wrongly return true; the engine value is the authority here.
